chunks: From him, from his father, from Yunus ibn Abd al-Rahman, with an unbroken chain, said:
Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said: 'There is no falsehood that stands opposite to the truth except that the truth will overcome the falsehood.'
And this is His Statement, the Mighty and Majestic: 'Nay! We cast the truth against the falsehood, so it breaks its head, and thereupon it vanishes.'
ai.seo_question: How does the Quran describe the relationship between truth and falsehood?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) elucidates the inevitable triumph of truth over falsehood, citing the Quranic metaphor of God casting truth against falsehood to shatter it. This narration, found in Al-Kafi, underscores the cosmic certainty of divine justice, assuring believers that despite the apparent strength of opposing forces, the ultimate outcome is always the vanquishing of falsehood.
